title: Inheritance of Ephraim

questions.question: The allotment of the people of Joseph went from the Jordan by what city?
questions.explanation: Joshua 16:1 (ESV): "The allotment of the people of Joseph went from the Jordan by Jericho..."

questions.question: From Jericho, where did the boundary go up to?
questions.explanation: Joshua 16:1-2 (ESV): "...going up from Jericho into the hill country to Bethel."

questions.question: Did Ephraim drive out the Canaanites who lived in Gezer?
questions.explanation: Joshua 16:10 (ESV): "However, they did not drive out the Canaanites who lived in Gezer..."

questions.question: What happened to the Canaanites in Gezer?
options: They lived in the midst of Ephraim and became forced laborers
questions.correctAnswer: They lived in the midst of Ephraim and became forced laborers
questions.explanation: Joshua 16:10 (ESV): "...so the Canaanites have lived in the midst of Ephraim to this day but have been made to do forced labor."

questions.question: Who received inheritance in this chapter?
options: The people of Joseph (Manasseh and Ephraim)
questions.correctAnswer: The people of Joseph (Manasseh and Ephraim)
questions.explanation: Joshua 16:4 (ESV): "The people of Joseph, Manasseh and Ephraim, received their inheritance."

questions.question: Where did the border go from Bethel?
questions.explanation: Joshua 16:2 (ESV): "It went out from Bethel to Luz..."

questions.question: The boundary descended westward to the territory of whom?
questions.explanation: Joshua 16:3 (ESV): "...descended westward to the territory of the Japhletites..."

questions.question: Where did the western boundary end?
questions.explanation: Joshua 16:3 (ESV): "...and it ended at the sea."

questions.question: Upper Beth-horon is mentioned as a boundary point. What other Beth-horon is listed?
questions.explanation: Joshua 16:3 (ESV): "...as far as the territory of Lower Beth-horon..."

questions.question: Were there cities set apart for Ephraim within Manasseh's inheritance?
questions.explanation: Joshua 16:9 (ESV): "along with the towns that were set apart for the people of Ephraim within the inheritance of the Manassites..."

questions.question: Gezer is located in whose inheritance?
questions.explanation: Joshua 16:10 describes the Canaanites in Gezer living in the midst of Ephraim.

questions.question: Ataroth is listed near which border?
questions.explanation: Joshua 16:3 (ESV): "...descended... to the territory of the Japhletites, as far as the territory of Lower Beth-horon, then to Gezer..." (Atarhoth mentioned in 16:2 crossing to Ataroth before Japhletites)

questions.question: Which son of Joseph is listed first in receiving inheritance in verse 4?
questions.explanation: Joshua 16:4 (ESV): "The people of Joseph, Manasseh and Ephraim, received their inheritance."

questions.question: The border of Ephraim on the east was related to what Ataroth?
questions.explanation: Joshua 16:5 (ESV): "...the boundary of their inheritance on the east was Ataroth-addar..."

questions.question: The Kanah Brook is associated with which direction boundary?
questions.explanation: Joshua 16:8 (ESV): "From Tappuah the boundary goes westward to the brook Kanah..." (This forms the northern boundary of Ephraim/Southern of Manasseh)

key_verse_text: However, they did not drive out the Canaanites who lived in Gezer, so the Canaanites have lived in the midst of Ephraim to this day but have been made to do forced labor. (ESV)
